proof_summary: Mass conservation and gaplessness, together with a bounded first moment that increases strictly before stability, ensure that every trajectory stabilizes. Coupling the mass-\(n+1\) trajectory to the mass-\(n\) trajectory plus one moving token, a leading-ones-front invariant places the token at position \(n-2\) or \(n-1\) when the latter stabilizes; it then walks one site per step to position \(n\), so the additional hitting time is respectively \(2\) or \(1\).
